meta.title: Find Job Assistant
meta.description:
Job-hunting assistant for DeepSeek Harness: profile your skills, batch-score job postings, draft outreach messages, tailor your resume, and analyze gaps.

For active job seekers: batch-identify postings worth applying to, with match reasons, greetings, and resume rewrites in one pass.
For those still employed: see clearly how you compare with target roles.

Runs and stores everything locally.
